HouseholdNode.title: HouseholdNode
HouseholdNode.description: Represents an electrical smart meter household node participating in P2P energy trading as a Consumer or Prosumer.

ownerId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the household owner.

houseName.description: Display name of the residence or solar node.

neighborhood.description: Microgrid feeder or neighborhood cluster name.

role.description: Active trading mode for the household node.

tokenBalanceKwh.description: Current available energy token balance in kWh.

withdrawableBalanceKes.description: Current earned prosumer escrow balance available for M-Pesa B2C withdrawal in KES.

totalExportedKwh.description: Cumulative surplus solar energy exported to the peer network in kWh.

totalConsumedKwh.description: Cumulative energy consumed by the household in kWh.

tariffKesPerKwh.description: Active P2P energy trading tariff in KES per kWh.

status.description: Operational state of the smart meter bridge.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the household node was registered.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the household node was last updated.

HouseholdPrivateInfo.title: HouseholdPrivateInfo
HouseholdPrivateInfo.description: Isolated PII document storing the user's registered Safaricom M-Pesa phone number and billing contact details.

ownerId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the household owner.

mpesaPhone.description: Registered Safaricom M-Pesa phone number in E.164 or 254 format.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of last PII update.

EnergyTransaction.title: EnergyTransaction
EnergyTransaction.description: Financial and token ledger entry recording C2B STK Push deposits, IoT meter P2P transfers, or B2C M-Pesa withdrawals.

ownerId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the household owner.

amountKwh.description: Energy quantity in kWh associated with the transaction.

mpesaReceipt.description: Safaricom Daraja receipt code or IoT telemetry batch reference.

counterpartyMeter.description: Counterparty smart meter ID or Daraja Paybill/B2C shortcode.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the transaction was recorded.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the transaction was last updated.

DailyEnergyMetric.title: DailyEnergyMetric
DailyEnergyMetric.description: Daily aggregated token consumption and solar export telemetry for historical charts and smart deposit prediction.

ownerId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the household owner.

consumedKwh.description: Total energy tokens consumed on this date in kWh.

exportedKwh.description: Total surplus solar energy exported to peers on this date in kWh.

costKes.description: Total KES value of consumed energy on this date.

revenueKes.description: Total KES earned from exported solar energy on this date.

peakHourKw.description: Peak instantaneous power draw or export in kW.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the daily metric was updated.

/households/{householdId}.description: Root collection of household smart meter nodes participating in the P2P energy grid.

/households/{householdId}/private/{docId.description: PII-isolated subcollection storing M-Pesa phone numbers and verified email addresses for a household.

/households/{householdId}/transactions/{.description: Subcollection of financial and token ledger entries for a specific household node.

/households/{householdId}/dailyMetrics/{.description: Subcollection of 30-day historical usage and solar export metrics for a specific household node.
